inlines.text: 本次发布汇集了 Google 系统语音模型和开放权重生态两方面的重大进展：
Android：借助 ML Kit 实现更快、更准确的系统语音模型：
由 Google 最新的端侧语音模型驱动，ML Kit 能以 10 倍实时速度，对 100 多种语言进行极其准确的多语言转写。与之搭配的是少步扩散 TTS 模型，仅约 100 毫秒即可开口说话，并以最高 50 倍实时速度合成 24 kHz 音频。两个模型都已集成到操作系统中，不会给你的 APK 增加 0 MB 体积。
Web、桌面及其他平台：借助 MediaPipe Tasks 和 LiteRT 实现跨平台、开放权重的语音能力：
针对跨平台应用，我们优化了新的 .litertlm 模型语音包，包括 Parakeet-TDT 0.6B、PocketTTS 100M、Kokoro-82M 和 Phonon 31M。它们能在紧凑的内存占用下提供实时流式转写和低延迟语音合成，并与端侧 SLM 顺畅并行运行，不会出现算力争抢。

ML Kit GenAI 语音识别 API
在用户说话时流式输出实时部分转写和最终转写，音频来源可以是设备内置麦克风，也可以是智能眼镜等外部音频流。我们最新的端侧 ASR 进展实现了覆盖 100 多种语言的高精度多语种识别（在 FLEURS 上词错误率为 8.0% 至 9.0%），转写速度比被转写的实时音频快 10 倍（每 3 秒语音约 300 毫秒），并将端到端语音翻译的等待时间缩短了 35% 至 44%。
ML Kit GenAI 文本转语音 API
由紧凑的少步扩散模型驱动，并在 NPU 上加速，端侧 TTS 约 100 毫秒即可开口，能以最高 50 倍实时速度生成自然的 24 kHz 语音，覆盖 8 种富有表现力的音色和 21 种语言区域。合成一段 27 秒的段落只需约 500 毫秒，同时相比传统自回归 TTS 模型，设备活跃功耗降低 50% 以上，并内置耳标（earcon）支持。

Today, we are introducing on-device Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Text-to-Speech (TTS) capabilities in Google AI Edge Gallery. Voice is often the most natural way to interact with AI on phones and wearables. Recent advances in compact speech architectures now make it possible to run accurate, multilingual ASR and expressive TTS models entirely on device, all within a small memory footprint, with low latency, and completely offline. By pairing these lightweight speech models with on-device small language models (SLMs) like Gemini Nano and Gemma 4, developers can build apps that stream live transcriptions as the user speaks and synthesize natural spoken replies locally.

blocks.text: This release brings together major advancements across both Google’s system speech models and the open-weight ecosystem:

inlines.text: This release brings together major advancements across both Google’s system speech models and the open-weight ecosystem:
Android: faster, more accurate system speech models with ML Kit:

Powered by Google’s latest on-device speech models, ML Kit delivers incredibly accurate multilingual transcription across 100+ languages at 10x real-time speed. It is paired with a few-step diffusion TTS model that begins speaking in just ~100 ms and synthesizes 24 kHz audio at up to 50x real-time speed. Both models are integrated into the OS, adding 0 MB to your APK.
Web, Desktop and Beyond: cross-platform, open-weight speech with MediaPipe Tasks and LiteRT:

For cross-platform apps, we optimized new .litertlm model speech bundles, including Parakeet-TDT 0.6B, PocketTTS 100M, Kokoro-82M, and Phonon 31M. They deliver real-time streaming transcription and low-latency speech synthesis in a compact memory footprint, and run smoothly alongside on-device SLMs without compute contention.

inlines.text: Multimodal voice tutoring with XR Language Teacher

blocks.text: Learning a language while traveling happens in the real world, often in underground stations, busy markets, or abroad where Wi-Fi and roaming data may not be available. To show how vision, language, and speech models can work together 100% locally on your phone with no network connection needed, we built the XR Language Teacher showcase in Google AI Edge Gallery. Simply point your camera at an unfamiliar object or menu, ask "What is that, and how do I ask for one?", and immediately hear an explanation in your language alongside authentic pronunciation in the local language.

blocks.text: Seeing, speaking, and learning entirely on device

inlines.text: Seeing, speaking, and learning entirely on device
Live visual grounding and streaming voice input:
Point your camera at a street sign, menu, or object and ask a question aloud. On-device ASR streams your spoken question in real time alongside the camera frame to
across other platforms—in a single pass.
Structured outputs for bilingual TTS code-switching:

Using a structured output schema, the model explains the scene in your own language while tagging foreign-language phrases separately, allowing the TTS pipeline to seamlessly switch voices and accents mid-sentence from your mother tongue to the target language alongside an on-screen vocabulary card.

ASR and TTS settings in Model Management:
Choose between available ASR and TTS pipelines, preset voices, and downloaded language packs in one central place.
Read-aloud playback with live sentence highlighting:

Turn on “Auto-play TTS” or tap the speaker button on any response to launch a floating TTS bar that highlights each spoken sentence in real time, with the ability to jump to any sentence by tapping it.
Reference implementation for chat voice outputs:

Our open-source codebase demonstrates how to strip Markdown syntax, skip non-spoken blocks like code snippets and tables, and schedule synthesis at the sentence level to avoid compute and memory contention during LLM token generation.

blocks.text: Building for flagship Android with ML Kit

inlines.text: Building for flagship Android with ML Kit

blocks.text: For developers building for Android devices, ML Kit’s GenAI Speech Recognition and Text-to-Speech APIs provide a standardized, platform-integrated path out of the box. With the underlying speech models managed through AICore and Google’s on-device speech services, developers get production-grade quality without having to manage model downloads or worry about APK size bloat. Your app also benefits automatically from hardware acceleration across NPU and TPU backends (when available) and seamless background model updates.

inlines.text: For developers building for Android devices,
ML Kit’s GenAI Speech Recognition and Text-to-Speech APIs

ML Kit GenAI Speech Recognition API

Streams live partial and final transcriptions as the user speaks, accepting audio from either the built-in device microphone or external audio streams such as smart glasses. Our latest on-device ASR advancements deliver incredibly accurate multilingual recognition across 100+ languages (reaching 8.0% to 9.0% Word Error Rate on FLEURS) while transcribing speech 10x faster than the real time audio being transcribed (~300 ms per 3 seconds of speech) and cutting end-to-end speech translation wait times by 35% to 44%.

Powered by a compact, few-step diffusion model accelerated on NPU, the on-device TTS begins speaking in ~100 ms and generates natural 24 kHz speech across 8 expressive voices and 21 locales at up to 50x real-time speed. It synthesizes a 27-second paragraph in just ~500 ms while cutting active device power by over 50% compared to traditional autoregressive TTS models, and includes built-in earcon support.

blocks.text: Powering cross-platform speech and flexible model support with LiteRT

inlines.text: Powering cross-platform speech and flexible model support with LiteRT

blocks.text: Under the hood, ML Kit and MediaPipe Tasks are powered by LiteRT, Google’s high-performance on-device AI inference infrastructure. Cross-platform applications requiring even more fine-grained control over speech processing or custom model architectures can also build on it directly.

inlines.text: Under the hood, ML Kit and MediaPipe Tasks are powered by

, Google’s high-performance on-device AI inference infrastructure. Cross-platform applications requiring even more fine-grained control over speech processing or custom model architectures can also build on it directly.

blocks.text: Speech models often rely on multiple subgraphs and auxiliary assets, such as encoder/decoder subgraphs and tokenizers for ASR, or phonemizer dictionaries, voice embeddings, and vocoders for TTS. All required components for each model are packaged into a single .litertlm file for easy deployment. The app ships with ready-to-use .litertlm models, including Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 (multilingual ASR), PocketTTS 100M (multilingual TTS), Phonon 31M (ultra-lightweight English TTS), and Kokoro-82M (multilingual TTS). Beyond these, the vibrant Hugging Face LiteRT Community with over 10K+ followers offers a growing catalog of open-weight models, like Whisper, Qwen3-ASR and Moonshine for ASR, or Qwen3-TTS and Matcha for TTS. For developers seeking custom implementations or support for additional open-weight voice models, LiteRT provides a rich set of multimodal model examples to help you get started, with more on the way.
